Hi Ben / Jordan,

Quick heads-up — our consolidated container SLDU1234567 (BOL: 654321/ACME-4578) hit customs review at DEN this morning. Customs is requesting a duty bond release before they will allow drayage to the advance warehouse. The show load-in is Dec 18 and we need the crate at Advance Warehouse 14 by end of day Dec 17 to meet the freight window.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide an executed duty bond release (or sign the attached bond request form) so the broker can clear without delays?
- Can you confirm last-mile shuttle availability for an evening pickup from the bonded yard on Dec 17 (approx window 18:00–22:00)?

Customs contact indicated they will hold until the bond paperwork is on file; if we miss the warehouse cutoff we'll be bumped to the next day and incur expo penalties.

I attached the commercial invoice we submitted and the customs hold notice. If AtlasDrayage or your broker needs a power of attorney we can send one.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — please advise by EOD today if possible.

Regards,
